Chiron.core_themes: wound, unutilized gift, teaching through pain

DSC.user_shorthand: who and what I meet here

MC.interprets_through: career, reputation, social role, public outcomes
MC.user_shorthand: how I am classified publicly here

IC.user_shorthand: what supports or unsettles my base here

Sun:ASC.summary: Sun on the ASC brings identity, vitality, and purpose into direct personal expression.
Sun:ASC.supportive_expression: Confidence, autonomy, and visible leadership can become easier to embody.
Sun:ASC.difficult_expression: Self-focus, ego inflation, or pressure to perform can crowd out receptivity.

Sun:DSC.summary: Sun on the DSC brings identity and recognition into partnerships, clients, and encounters with others.
Sun:DSC.supportive_expression: Significant alliances and visibility through collaboration can develop.
Sun:DSC.difficult_expression: Competition, projection, or dependence on another person's validation can dominate relationships.

Sun:MC.summary: Sun on the MC directs purpose and vitality toward vocation, reputation, and public contribution.
Sun:MC.supportive_expression: Leadership, recognition, and a clearer sense of calling can grow.
Sun:MC.difficult_expression: Status pressure, overexposure, or public ego conflicts can become draining.

Sun:IC.summary: Sun on the IC anchors identity and purpose in home, roots, family, and private foundations.
Sun:IC.supportive_expression: A stronger sense of belonging and confident stewardship of the home base can develop.
Sun:IC.difficult_expression: Family ego conflicts or retreat into a private identity can limit wider participation.

Moon:ASC.summary: Moon on the ASC makes emotion, care, and instinct highly visible in the body and personal style.
Moon:ASC.supportive_expression: Intuition, responsiveness, and an approachable presence can deepen.
Moon:ASC.difficult_expression: Mood reactivity, dependency, or over-identification with immediate feelings can unsettle the self.

Moon:DSC.summary: Moon on the DSC brings emotional needs, care, and belonging into partnerships and public encounters.
Moon:DSC.supportive_expression: Supportive bonds, family-like alliances, and mutual responsiveness can form.
Moon:DSC.difficult_expression: Dependency, projection, or volatile relational patterns can become difficult to contain.

Moon:MC.summary: Moon on the MC places care, receptivity, and changing public needs at the center of vocation and reputation.
Moon:MC.supportive_expression: Public rapport, service, and work with families or communities can flourish.
Moon:MC.difficult_expression: Reputation may fluctuate with moods or changing audiences, and emotional labor can become excessive.

Moon:IC.summary: Moon on the IC concentrates belonging, memory, care, and family life in the private foundation.
Moon:IC.supportive_expression: Nesting, kinship, emotional restoration, and attachment to place can strengthen.
Moon:IC.difficult_expression: Family entanglement, dependency, or a moody home atmosphere can make separation and perspective harder.

Mercury:ASC.summary: Mercury on the ASC makes curiosity, language, mobility, and exchange central to personal expression.
Mercury:ASC.supportive_expression: Learning, writing, networking, and adaptable self-presentation can accelerate.
Mercury:ASC.difficult_expression: Nervousness, scattered focus, or constant motion can weaken continuity.

Mercury:DSC.summary: Mercury on the DSC channels communication, trade, and analysis through partners, clients, and negotiations.
Mercury:DSC.supportive_expression: Client work, contracts, dialogue, and intellectually lively alliances can thrive.
Mercury:DSC.difficult_expression: Argument, over-analysis, or unreliable agreements can keep relationships unsettled.

Mercury:MC.summary: Mercury on the MC directs communication, learning, trade, and analysis into career and public reputation.
Mercury:MC.supportive_expression: Writing, teaching, sales, media, and versatile professional roles can advance.
Mercury:MC.difficult_expression: Overextension, career restlessness, or a fragmented public message can undermine authority.

Mercury:IC.summary: Mercury on the IC brings mental activity, exchange, and movement into home, roots, and family life.
Mercury:IC.supportive_expression: Home study, writing, family dialogue, and a flexible base can be productive.
Mercury:IC.difficult_expression: Frequent moves, nervous domestic routines, or too much analysis can make the base hard to settle into.

Venus:ASC.summary: Venus on the ASC makes harmony, beauty, attraction, and diplomacy part of the visible personal style.
Venus:ASC.supportive_expression: Social ease, artistic expression, and a gracious presence can draw support.
Venus:ASC.difficult_expression: Passivity, indulgence, or dependence on appearance and approval can dilute agency.

Venus:DSC.summary: Venus on the DSC brings love, harmony, pleasure, and aesthetics into partnership and client relationships.
Venus:DSC.supportive_expression: Romance, diplomacy, collaboration, and mutually enjoyable alliances can flourish.
Venus:DSC.difficult_expression: People-pleasing, dependency, or avoidance of necessary conflict can weaken agreements.

Venus:MC.summary: Venus on the MC directs aesthetics, diplomacy, attraction, and social grace toward career and reputation.
Venus:MC.supportive_expression: Art, design, mediation, public relations, and well-received work can prosper.
Venus:MC.difficult_expression: Popularity seeking, complacency, or tying reputation too closely to approval can limit substance.

Venus:IC.summary: Venus on the IC brings affection, beauty, comfort, and harmony into home, roots, and private life.
Venus:IC.supportive_expression: A hospitable, restorative, and aesthetically satisfying base can develop.
Venus:IC.difficult_expression: Luxury costs, passivity, or smoothing over unresolved family issues can weaken the foundation.

Mars:ASC.summary: Mars on the ASC makes drive, heat, courage, and assertion immediate in the body and personal style.
Mars:ASC.supportive_expression: Initiative, physical momentum, and the courage to act independently can intensify.
Mars:ASC.difficult_expression: Irritability, haste, conflict, or accident-prone overexertion can accompany constant activation.

Mars:DSC.summary: Mars on the DSC brings assertion, competition, and heat through partners, clients, allies, and opponents.
Mars:DSC.supportive_expression: Direct negotiation, energetic teamwork, and decisive partnerships can move quickly.
Mars:DSC.difficult_expression: Disputes, rivalry, hostility, or projecting anger onto others can dominate encounters.

Mars:MC.summary: Mars on the MC directs ambition, action, courage, and competition toward career and public outcomes.
Mars:MC.supportive_expression: Entrepreneurial momentum, leadership, and decisive professional action can accelerate.
Mars:MC.difficult_expression: Career conflict, burnout, or an impulsive public reputation can undermine durable progress.

Mars:IC.summary: Mars on the IC concentrates drive and heat in home, roots, family, and private foundations, making the base active rather than restful.
Mars:IC.supportive_expression: Decisive changes, building, repair, and firmer household boundaries can be supported.
Mars:IC.difficult_expression: Restlessness, domestic abrasion, family conflict, or an inability to settle can exhaust the private base.

Jupiter:ASC.summary: Jupiter on the ASC makes growth, optimism, meaning, and opportunity part of personal expression.
Jupiter:ASC.supportive_expression: Confidence, teaching, travel, and an expansive sense of possibility can develop.
Jupiter:ASC.difficult_expression: Excess, self-righteousness, or over-promising can make personal growth unsustainable.

Jupiter:DSC.summary: Jupiter on the DSC brings growth, opportunity, and meaning through partners, advisers, and clients.
Jupiter:DSC.supportive_expression: Benefactors, international alliances, teaching relationships, and generous collaboration can appear.
Jupiter:DSC.difficult_expression: Over-trust, inflated promises, or reliance on another person's luck can obscure practical limits.

Jupiter:MC.summary: Jupiter on the MC directs expansion, opportunity, teaching, and meaning toward career and public status.
Jupiter:MC.supportive_expression: Professional growth, leadership, recognition, and educational or international work can prosper.
Jupiter:MC.difficult_expression: Overreach, complacency, or an inflated public standing can outpace real capacity.

Jupiter:IC.summary: Jupiter on the IC expands home, roots, family, and the material or emotional base.
Jupiter:IC.supportive_expression: A generous, spacious, hospitable, and supportive foundation can grow.
Jupiter:IC.difficult_expression: Property costs, family excess, or expansion that repeatedly uproots the household can become burdensome.

Saturn:ASC.summary: Saturn on the ASC makes duty, realism, restraint, and structure central to personal expression.
Saturn:ASC.supportive_expression: Discipline, boundaries, endurance, and mature self-command can strengthen.
Saturn:ASC.difficult_expression: Heaviness, isolation, harsh self-judgment, or excessive restraint can narrow life.

Saturn:DSC.summary: Saturn on the DSC brings commitment, limits, duty, and testing through partners and contracts.
Saturn:DSC.supportive_expression: Durable agreements, loyalty, accountability, and serious alliances can form.
Saturn:DSC.difficult_expression: Coldness, delay, controlling ties, or carrying another person's burdens can restrict relationship life.

Saturn:MC.summary: Saturn on the MC directs responsibility, structure, realism, and mastery toward career and reputation.
Saturn:MC.supportive_expression: Authority, long-term achievement, disciplined leadership, and earned credibility can develop.
Saturn:MC.difficult_expression: Delay, status rigidity, work pressure, or professional isolation can make success feel heavy.

Saturn:IC.summary: Saturn on the IC places duty, limits, and structure in home, roots, family, and private foundations.
Saturn:IC.supportive_expression: A durable base, property stewardship, and dependable family responsibilities can be built.
Saturn:IC.difficult_expression: Loneliness, domestic restriction, inherited burdens, or slow settlement can weigh on private life.

Uranus:ASC.summary: Uranus on the ASC makes freedom, disruption, originality, and reinvention central to identity.
Uranus:ASC.supportive_expression: Independence, experimentation, and a liberating new personal direction can emerge.
Uranus:ASC.difficult_expression: Nervousness, abrupt changes, or instability can make identity and routines difficult to sustain.

Uranus:DSC.summary: Uranus on the DSC brings freedom, surprise, and unconventional patterns through partners and clients.
Uranus:DSC.supportive_expression: Stimulating networks, non-traditional bonds, and inventive collaboration can form.
Uranus:DSC.difficult_expression: Unreliable ties, abrupt separations, or shocks through others can destabilize agreements.

Uranus:MC.summary: Uranus on the MC directs innovation, independence, and disruption toward career and public role.
Uranus:MC.supportive_expression: Technology, reform, breakthrough work, and an original reputation can advance.
Uranus:MC.difficult_expression: Abrupt career changes, authority conflict, or public volatility can erode continuity.

Uranus:IC.summary: Uranus on the IC brings freedom, disruption, and reinvention into home, roots, and private foundations.
Uranus:IC.supportive_expression: Independent living, fresh domestic arrangements, and release from stale family patterns can develop.
Uranus:IC.difficult_expression: Sudden moves, domestic unrest, or difficulty putting down roots can prevent a stable refuge.

Neptune:ASC.summary: Neptune on the ASC makes sensitivity, imagination, spirituality, and permeability visible in identity.
Neptune:ASC.supportive_expression: Artistry, empathy, inspiration, and contemplative self-expression can deepen.
Neptune:ASC.difficult_expression: Blurred identity, projection, confusion, or escapism can make boundaries difficult to hold.

Neptune:DSC.summary: Neptune on the DSC brings idealization, compassion, imagination, and uncertainty through relationships.
Neptune:DSC.supportive_expression: Creative, spiritual, or deeply empathic bonds can form.
Neptune:DSC.difficult_expression: Deception, savior-victim dynamics, projection, or weak boundaries can obscure who the other person is.

Neptune:MC.summary: Neptune on the MC directs vision, imagination, compassion, and ambiguity toward vocation and reputation.
Neptune:MC.supportive_expression: Art, spiritual service, healing work, and inspired public contribution can flourish.
Neptune:MC.difficult_expression: Unclear career direction, reputation confusion, exploitation, or impractical promises can undermine results.

Neptune:IC.summary: Neptune on the IC makes home, roots, family, and livelihood foundations more sensitive, imaginative, and porous.
Neptune:IC.supportive_expression: A creative, spiritual, compassionate, or retreat-like private base can develop.
Neptune:IC.difficult_expression: Unreliable foundations, secrecy, false hope, or weak material due diligence can make home and livelihood unstable.

Pluto:ASC.summary: Pluto on the ASC makes intensity, power, regeneration, and self-confrontation central to identity.
Pluto:ASC.supportive_expression: Self-mastery, strategic courage, and profound personal reinvention can develop.
Pluto:ASC.difficult_expression: Obsession, control, crisis, or an intimidating impact can make ordinary self-expression difficult.

Pluto:DSC.summary: Pluto on the DSC brings power, intensity, and transformation through partners, clients, and adversaries.
Pluto:DSC.supportive_expression: Deep honesty, consequential alliances, and transformative collaboration can emerge.
Pluto:DSC.difficult_expression: Coercion, jealousy, manipulation, or power struggles can consume relationships.

Pluto:MC.summary: Pluto on the MC directs power, strategy, regeneration, and transformation toward career and reputation.
Pluto:MC.supportive_expression: Influence, reform, crisis leadership, and strategic professional renewal can grow.
Pluto:MC.difficult_expression: Public power struggles, compulsion, or extreme reputation shifts can overwhelm the original goal.

Pluto:IC.summary: Pluto on the IC concentrates ancestral, psychological, and power themes in home, roots, and private foundations.
Pluto:IC.supportive_expression: Deep family repair, reclamation of the base, and private regeneration can occur.
Pluto:IC.difficult_expression: Hidden conflict, control, obsession, or upheaval at home can make the foundation intense rather than restful.

North Node:ASC.summary: North Node on the ASC is a secondary locational variant that links group relationships and developmental pull with personal direction.
North Node:ASC.supportive_expression: Future-facing participation, new networks, and a fresh way of presenting oneself can be explored.
North Node:ASC.difficult_expression: Treating every identity shift as destined can overstate this non-planetary extension.

North Node:DSC.summary: North Node on the DSC is a secondary variant that brings group relationships and developmental pull through partners and contacts.
North Node:DSC.supportive_expression: Meaningful networks, collaboration, and introductions to new communities can develop.
North Node:DSC.difficult_expression: Over-reading contacts as fated or depending on group approval can distort relationship judgment.

North Node:MC.summary: North Node on the MC is a secondary variant that connects group relationships and developmental pull with public direction.
North Node:MC.supportive_expression: Networks, community contribution, and a future-facing public role can grow.
North Node:MC.difficult_expression: Claiming career destiny without natal context can give this extension more certainty than its sources support.

North Node:IC.summary: North Node on the IC is a secondary variant that brings developmental and group themes into home, ancestry, and belonging.
North Node:IC.supportive_expression: A new community, chosen family, or future-facing home base can be explored.
North Node:IC.difficult_expression: Forced fate narratives or group expectations can displace practical family and housing realities.

Chiron:ASC.summary: Chiron on the ASC is a secondary locational variant that makes wounds, unutilized gifts, and teaching through pain visible in identity.
Chiron:ASC.supportive_expression: Self-knowledge, mentoring, and integration of a previously neglected gift can develop.
Chiron:ASC.difficult_expression: Public vulnerability, reopened pain, or identifying mainly with woundedness can narrow the self.

Chiron:DSC.summary: Chiron on the DSC is a secondary variant that brings wounding, repair, and mentoring through partnerships.
Chiron:DSC.supportive_expression: Therapeutic alliances, empathy, and mutual learning can deepen.
Chiron:DSC.difficult_expression: Rescuer-victim patterns or repeated relational hurt can reopen what the bond was meant to integrate.

Chiron:MC.summary: Chiron on the MC is a secondary variant that directs wounded knowledge, teaching, and integration toward vocation and reputation.
Chiron:MC.supportive_expression: Mentoring, counseling, teaching, and public use of hard-earned insight can grow.
Chiron:MC.difficult_expression: Public exposure of pain or building a role entirely around injury can become limiting.

Chiron:IC.summary: Chiron on the IC is a secondary variant that locates wounds, unutilized gifts, and repair in family, roots, and the private base.
Chiron:IC.supportive_expression: Ancestral repair, a restorative home, and teaching from lived experience can develop.
Chiron:IC.difficult_expression: Reopened family pain, caretaker burdens, or difficulty feeling at home can keep the foundation tender.
